tonight.headline: Jefferson and Coker both sat out Wednesday
body: Week 4 hasn't started. ESPN has you at 129.6 against Aye-Aye's 125.1, 52%. The bad news: Justin Jefferson (ankle) and Jalen Coker (quad) were both non-participants on Wednesday, and O'Connell won't say what it means for Sunday.
Nothing to do today. Allen practised without issue and is off the list. Friday's report decides Jefferson, because McLaurin locks at 07:30 Sunday in London, five hours before Jefferson's inactives.

case.label: The risk
case.body: Jefferson's 18.7 hasn't moved since this morning, so Wednesday's DNP isn't in it. Coker's fell from 13.8 to 13.0, so his is. If Jefferson sits, the two late fallbacks are Coker, who also didn't practise, and Jordan Addison, a free agent here.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jefferson limited or better on Thursday and Friday: then he plays and nothing fires.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · fire on Friday OUT/DOUBTFUL · before Sun 07:30 Mexico City (London)
doFirst.title: If Jefferson is ruled out Friday, McLaurin takes his WR slot
doFirst.subtitle: Carried, and closer to firing: Jefferson didn't practise Wednesday.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Right-ankle sprain on his seventh snap against Tampa Bay. Did not participate Wednesday; O'Connell: day-to-day, 'not in any place right now to talk about what that means for the weekend' (Vikings.com, 30 Sep). Schefter reported the DNP at 18:28 ET (NBC). ESPN still projects 18.7, so this isn't priced.

case.label: The clock
case.body: McLaurin kicks off in London at 07:30 Sunday; Jefferson's inactives come at 12:35. So an OUT or DOUBTFUL on Friday means moving McLaurin into Jefferson's WR slot before 07:30 and filling the flex with Coker (if cleared) or Addison, whichever ESPN projects higher on Friday.

case.label: The quarterback
case.body: McLaurin's passer is still open: Daniels was limited Wednesday and Quinn says 'by Friday we'll have a definite determination' (FOX, 30 Sep). Mariota threw three touchdowns in last week's win.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: It fires and McLaurin scores less than the best bench alternative that week.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · if Jefferson is inactive at Sun 12:35 Mexico City
doFirst.title: If Jefferson is a Sunday inactive: add Addison, drop Monangai
doFirst.subtitle: The WR slot's only same-game cover. Coker didn't practise either.

case.label: The role
case.body: Addison is Minnesota's WR1 when Jefferson sits: 5-90-1 on 9 targets in Week 3 after Jefferson left (Athlon 29 Sep); 22% target share without him against 17% with (DK Network). Kyler Murray starts; Yahoo calls Miami 'a much easier challenge' (30 Sep). A free agent here, 76% owned, no priority cost.

case.label: Why not Coker
case.body: Coker is the lineup tool's fallback, but he was a non-participant Wednesday with the quad (Panthers.com, 30 Sep) and his inactives aren't until 16:50. If he's cleared by Friday and projects higher than Addison at 12:35, start Coker instead and skip the add.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Monangai: 10 carries a week behind D'Andre Swift, outsnapped 50-22 in Week 3 (4for4). Not on the screen's exposure list.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: It fires and Addison scores less than Coker or Kamara that week.

whatWentWrong.title: Jefferson missed Wednesday and the projection didn't notice
whatWentWrong.lead: 18.7 this morning, 18.7 now, after a DNP and a coach who won't commit. That's the gap the two cards cover.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Vikings Wednesday report: Jefferson DNP (ankle). O'Connell: they won't accelerate it (Vikings.com 30 Sep).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Limited on Thursday, full on Friday: then he plays and the cards stay unarmed.

whatWentWrong.title: Both WR fallbacks are hurt or locked
whatWentWrong.lead: Coker DNP, Boston plays Thursday, McLaurin locks at 07:30 Sunday. Addison is the only clean same-game cover.

case.label: The tool
case.body: lineup_check.py names Coker as Jefferson's fallback. It ranks by projection and ignores both Coker's DNP and the kickoff order.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Coker practising fully by Friday: then he's the fallback again and no add is needed.
